description: Cursor-Governance binding to the canonical memory control plane (l9-graphiti-memory). Read by ops/memory/runtime_binding.py, which proves the exact package, interpreter, and console script before any lifecycle call. This is a Cursor-owned statement of what Cursor expects to run; it grants nothing and resolves no provider. Production binding is an immutable release artifact locked in uv.lock; MEMORY_TARGET_VERSION is release 2.3.0 (cut at campaign stage M2 on the memory PR); integration binds the exact git SHA of that release below until the v2.3.0 tag is on origin and uv.lock carries the artifact.

source.ref_note: Release 2.3.0 = MEMORY_TARGET_VERSION (campaign stage M2, Quantum-L9/l9-graphiti-memory#56): tag selector on search/hydrate, client cursor verify --path proving the installed entry, installed-wheel lifecycle proof, shared control-plane fixture. This SHA is the M2 head; replace it with the v2.3.0 tag once the memory PR merges and the tag is cut, and lock the artifact in uv.lock.

binding_policy.production: exact release artifact locked in uv.lock; runtime_mode=pinned_environment
binding_policy.integration: exact git SHA above, installed as a built wheel into the governance environment; runtime_mode=pinned_environment
binding_policy.development: L9_MEMORY_DEV_CHECKOUT=<path to a l9-graphiti-memory checkout with .venv>; runtime_mode=development_checkout, never silent
forbidden: whatever l9-memory is first on PATH
an adjacent checkout discovered by directory scanning
pip install -e of a sibling checkout without the development opt-in
